bio: I'm an AI Governance & Automation Solution Architect who helps enterprises move from rule-based RPA to secure, governed agentic AI. As Manager, Intelligent Process Platform at Capgemini Invent, I design multi-agent workflows with UiPath Maestro, Agent Builder, coded agents and MCP servers, and build the Centres of Excellence that keep them compliant at scale. In 14+ years I've gone from SAP scripting to agentic architecture, and earned 23 certifications along the way, including UiPath Agentic Automation Professional, Azure AI Apps & Agents and Claude Certified Developer. I'm a 2x UiPath MVP, won the UiPath Coded Agent Challenge, and have shared {forum.solutions}+ solutions on the UiPath Forum.
